title: Low-Degree Weight of a Flipped Parity Function
statement: For each natural number $k$, consider the parity function on the $(k+1)$-dimensional sign cube that is negated at the all-positive input and unchanged elsewhere. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of this function's real-valued sign representation over subsets of size at most $k$ equals $(2^{k+1}-1)\,((1/2)^k)^2$.
